_doc: Venue registry for scripts/ingest-venue-events.ts. URLs found + assigned by research (May 2026). `render: true` = the page is JS-rendered or 403s a bare fetch, so the agent loads it in a headless browser (Playwright). Social-only sources (Instagram/Facebook) are noted but NOT scraped — see docs/EXTRACTION_PLATFORM.md for the partnership/vision/human path. Verify URLs periodically; the agent validates at fetch time and never fabricates.

venues.name: The Banyan
venues.note: 216 E. Patrick St. Same team as The Derby (New Market). Rooftop + 2nd-floor live music; lineup builds out through 2026.

venues.name: Weinberg Center for the Arts
venues.note: Historic 1926 theater. 403s a bare fetch → render. Also covers New Spire Arts programming.

venues.name: Sky Stage
venues.note: Open-air FAC venue, 59 S. Carroll St. Calendar is JS-rendered → render.

venues.name: New Spire Arts
venues.note: 15 W. Patrick St. Managed by the Weinberg Center; programming listed there.

venues.name: Bushwaller's
venues.note: Oldest Irish pub in Frederick, 209 N. Market St. Live music upstairs; events page is a JS widget → render.

venues.name: Cellar Door
venues.note: 5 E. Church St. Open mic, DJ, comedy, karaoke. Squarespace entertainment page → render.

venues.name: Bentztown
venues.note: 6 S. Bentz St. Southern food + bourbon + live-music stage. Its OWN site (bentztown.com) is CAPTCHA-walled ("prove you're human") — un-scrapable by any agent, verified May 2026. Read the lineup from its Bandsintown venue page instead: no CAPTCHA, ~33 upcoming shows with real dates, render:true. Bandsintown also carries Weinberg + other Frederick venues — treat it as a primary aggregator source per docs/EXTRACTION_PLATFORM.md.

venues.name: JoJo's Restaurant & Tap House
venues.note: 16 E. Patrick St. Dining, happy hour & live music. Find/verify an events/calendar URL (posts heavily on social); leave empty until a non-social source exists.

venues.name: The Derby (New Market)
venues.note: Live music Wed–Sat. Posts on Instagram/Facebook (@thederbymd) — social-only; needs the partnership/vision path, not blind scraping. URL left empty until a non-social source exists.
